summary: Contract/freeze phase only -- no advisory implementation, no runtime behavior changes, no execution capability; no file under src/pcae/ touched. Freezes the Advisory Runtime contracts (113A) before any advisory implementation begins. New principle: Explainability precedes trust. Freezes a fourteen-field AdvisoryResult contract (113A's nine extended by five: source_snapshot_reference, reasoning_summary, alternative_considerations, remediation, implementation_status; the brief's suggested recommendation field reconciled into 113A's existing recommended_action rather than duplicated), an eight-facet explainability contract plus a reproducibility principle (restating 110A section 6's Deterministic Runtime Principle for Analysis specifically), a one-shape EvidenceReference evidence model (no evidence database, no audit persistence), advisory-category extension rules (open taxonomy, frozen meanings), severity/confidence semantics (four levels each, explicitly orthogonal, fail-closed ambiguity handling), a six-stage advisory lifecycle (contract only), a presentation contract (one model, many renderers), ten absolute safety rules (113A's seven plus deny/imply-approval/bypass-review-or-audit), and compatibility rules mirroring 112F's own discipline (no versioning field implemented this phase, consistent with 112F's own precedent). Added docs/PCAE_ADVISORY_RUNTIME_CONTRACT.md, docs/PHASE_113_ADVISORY_RUNTIME_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated, no change needed. 158 new tests (tests/test_advisory_runtime_contract.py), a pure documentation-verification suite.
